final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make all tests pass and ensure the functions behave as specified in their docstrings:

- In inventory/export.py, I updated to_csv_row to properly escape item names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180.
- In inventory/pricing.py, I enhanced parse_price to handle commas in prices and accounting-style negative numbers with parentheses. I also fixed apply_discount to use Decimal arithmetic and round half up correctly.
- In inventory/report.py, I corrected low_stock to return item names with quantity strictly below the threshold, sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

After these fixes, the entire test suite passes successfully.
